scripts.dev: bun run build && concurrently -k -n server,vite -c blue,green "bun run dev:wrangler" "bun run dev:vite"
scripts.preview: bun run build && NODE_ENV=production bun run dev:wrangler
scripts.test:db:dev: wrangler d1 execute inertia-crud --local --command "select * from products";
scripts.test:db: wrangler d1 execute inertia-crud --remote --command "select * from products";
scripts.studio:db:dev: cross-env LOCAL_DB_PATH=$(find .wrangler/state/v3/d1/miniflare-D1DatabaseObject -type f -name '*.sqlite' -print0 | xargs -0 ls -t | head -1) drizzle-kit studio --config=drizzle.config.local.ts
scripts.dbcat:db:dev: cross-env find .wrangler/state/v3/d1/miniflare-D1DatabaseObject -type f -name '*.sqlite' -print0 | xargs -0 ls -t | head -1 | xargs bunx dbcat
